title: Machine learning selects CPT1A, CYGB and MRPL3 as oxidative stress-related genes in pre-eclampsia
summary: WGCNA, LASSO and SVM-RFE on dataset GSE60438 yielded three genes (CPT1A, CYGB, MRPL3) used in a diagnostic model with an AUC of 0.930. Silencing CPT1A alleviated trophoblast dysfunction, lowered ROS and reduced apoptosis under hypoxia/reoxygenation. Results rest on a single public dataset without an independent patient cohort, and only CPT1A was tested functionally.
ai_technology: WGCNA with LASSO and SVM-RFE for feature gene selection and a diagnostic model

evidence.tested: Validation split of GSE60438 and CPT1A silencing in hypoxia/reoxygenation-treated trophoblasts.
evidence.unknown: Clinical diagnostic use; function of CYGB and MRPL3.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning algorithms selected the three feature genes.
